findings.rationale: Computing eight states verifies the listed prefix. A domain reviewer should confirm the recurrence returns to the same ordered state pair and therefore repeats indefinitely.

findings.summary: The slice should keep periodic bounded behavior separate from asymptotic stability.
findings.rationale: A periodic trajectory can be bounded without converging to an equilibrium. Review language must not imply that oscillation alone proves instability under every stability definition.
findings.suggested_action: Confirm terminology with a control-systems reviewer and preserve the model-specific scope.
